content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Faculty Recruitment Important Dates
content_sections.text: Note: Age and all other qualifications will be counted as on the closing date of application (5:00 PM of 12 September 2026). Candidates must satisfy eligibility as on this date, failing which their application will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Faculty Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Note: The official notification provides a detailed department × grade × category vacancy grid. The department, grade, and category totals below have each been independently cross-checked to sum to 190 and match the notification's own totals row; for the full category breakdown within each individual department/grade cell, please refer to the official PDF linked below. Important: Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation at the discretion of the Executive Director, AIIMS Jodhpur, as per Government of India rules/circulars.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Faculty Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Recruitment Rules for Professor/Additional Professor/Associate Professor are generic in nature - candidates must apply only for the department/specialty in which they hold the requisite qualification and experience. Non-Medical candidacy is available only for Anatomy (M.Sc. Human Anatomy/Anatomy), Biochemistry (M.Sc. Medical Biochemistry/Biochemistry), and Physiology (M.Sc. Medical Physiology/Physiology) departments, each requiring an additional Doctorate degree from a recognized university. Note: Orthopaedics and Paediatric Surgery carry vacancies in the notification's overview table but no separate Assistant Professor qualification is listed for these two departments in the source document - their posts appear to fall only under the Professor/Additional Professor/Associate Professor grades. Candidates interested in these departments should verify grade eligibility directly against the official PDF. A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 is required for all medical posts (candidates with Part-II qualifications must also satisfy Section 13(3) conditions). Only experience acquired after obtaining the essential qualifying degree for the applied post is counted. DNB Equivalence: Candidates holding DNB (broad specialty) or DrNB (super-specialty) as their essential qualification must provide documentary evidence of equivalence with MD/MS/DM/M.Ch as per MCI/NMC notification dated 31.10.2018, along with proof that training was done in an institution with an attached hospital (or 500+ bed hospital recognized by NBE), or one year of senior residency in an NMC-recognized teaching institution after passing DNB/DrNB. SC/ST candidates may be granted relaxation of up to 1 year in the required experience, at the discretion of the competent authority. Candidates may apply for more than one post, but must submit a separate online application for each.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Faculty Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination. Selection is through bio-data-based shortlisting followed by a Personal Interview at AIIMS Jodhpur. Merely possessing the prescribed minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to selection; the Selection Committee shortlists candidates for interview based on bio-data. Shortlisted candidates must produce all original documents at the time of interview. Interviews will be held at AIIMS Jodhpur; no TA/DA is paid for appearing. Minimum interview cut-off marks: 60% for EWS/UR, 55% for OBC, 50% for SC/ST/PwBD categories.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.aiimsjodhpur.edu.in and locate the online faculty recruitment application link. Register and complete the online application form, ensuring photo and signature are clearly visible in preview (small or unclear images will lead to rejection). Upload Educational Qualification Certificates as specified in the Recruitment Rules, along with any Certificate of Equivalence if applicable, and a valid Experience Certificate stating exact dates and nature of experience. Upload category certificate (EWS/SC/ST/OBC) in the prescribed format, if claiming reservation. Upload No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently employed in Government/Semi-Government/Government-funded institutions. Pay the prescribed application fee online through the AIIMS Jodhpur payment gateway. Submit the application before the closing date and retain a copy of the application form and payment proof for your records (no physical documents need to be sent). Important: Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate online application for each post. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification Certificates as specified in the Recruitment Rules for the applied post (medical qualifications must have valid National/State Medical Council registration) Certificate of Equivalent Qualification (if applicable), stating the authority, order number, date, and specific equivalence declared Experience Certificate(s) issued by the Head(s) of the organization, stating exact "from" and "to" dates, nature of experience (teaching/research/both), and recognition of the organization (MCI/NMC for medical, DCI for dental, UGC for non-medical) DNB/DrNB equivalence documentary evidence, if applicable Category certificate (EWS/SC/ST/OBC) in the DoPT-prescribed format, with non-creamy layer status for OBC candidates PwBD Disability Certificate from a competent Medical Board (Central/State Government constituted), if claiming benchmark disability benefits No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer, mandatory for candidates currently employed in Government/Semi-Government/Government-funded autonomous institutions Proof of application fee payment (challan/online payment receipt) Relieving Certificate from present employer, required at the time of joining for candidates already in Government service

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: If a candidate indicates a category (EWS/SC/ST/OBC/General) in the application form but later requests a change, such requests will not be entertained by the Institute. OBC candidates must submit a valid caste certificate in the DoPT-prescribed format with non-creamy layer status; a certificate issued in FY 2026-27 is required, though older certificates/acknowledgement slips are provisionally accepted pending renewal. EWS candidates must submit a valid Income & Asset Certificate for FY 2026-27 (based on FY 2025-26 income), issued by a competent authority; older certificates are provisionally accepted pending renewal. PwBD reservation (4% horizontal) applies to posts identified suitable for specific benchmark disabilities across 11 departments: Biochemistry, Microbiology, Otorhinolaryngology (ENT), Psychiatry, Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology, Urology, Pulmonary Medicine, Radiation Oncology/Radiotherapy, Anatomy, Pharmacology, and Dentistry. Out of 190 total posts, 7 posts (1 Professor-HH, 1 Additional Professor-Locomotor, 1 Associate Professor-HH, 4 Assistant Professor) are earmarked for PwBD candidates. If an EWS-earmarked vacancy cannot be filled due to non-availability of a suitable EWS candidate, it will not be carried forward as backlog; other category candidates may be provisionally allowed to apply, considered only as UR if the EWS vacancy remains otherwise unfilled. Canvassing of any kind will result in disqualification. The candidate must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Selected candidates are likely to be posted at rural health and urban centers attached to the Institute for a period decided by the Institute. AIIMS Jodhpur reserves the right to increase, decrease, or amend the number of vacancies and the recruitment process without prior notice. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Court of Law at Jodhpur; in case of ambiguity, Central Government Rules will prevail.

faq.question: Q1. How many faculty posts are available at AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: A total of 190 Group ‘A’ faculty posts are available across 40 departments and 4 grades — Professor (34), Additional Professor (17), Associate Professor (26), and Assistant Professor (113).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close at 5:00 PM on 12 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for AIIMS Jodhpur faculty posts?
faq.answer: Professor/Additional Professor: not exceeding 58 years; Associate Professor/Assistant Professor: not exceeding 50 years, as on the closing date, with applicable category relaxation.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam for AIIMS Jodhpur faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Selection is through bio-data-based shortlisting followed by a Personal Interview at AIIMS Jodhpur; there is no written test.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹3,000 for General/OBC/EWS candidates; ₹200 for SC/ST/Women/PwBD candidates (refundable to those who appear for interview).

faq.question: Q6. Can Non-Medical candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but only for Anatomy, Biochemistry, and Physiology departments (Professor/Additional Professor/Associate Professor grades), requiring a relevant Master’s degree plus a Doctorate from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q7. Are OCI cardholders eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders under Section 7(A) of the Citizenship Act, 1955 are eligible to apply for teaching posts as per MHA guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for AIIMS Jodhpur faculty posts?
faq.answer: Basic pay ranges from ₹1,01,500 (Assistant Professor, Level 12) to ₹1,68,900 (Professor, Level 14A), plus usual allowances and NPA for medically qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate online application must be submitted for each post applied to.

faq.question: Q10. What is the minimum interview cut-off for selection?
faq.answer: 60% for EWS/UR, 55% for OBC, and 50% for SC/ST/PwBD categories.
